description: List the Edgegap agent skills: tested, step-by-step workflows for getting a multiplayer game online on Edgegap, with templates (Dockerfiles, matchmaker configs, Unity C# and Unreal C++ drop-ins) and known pitfalls. Before working on a game project, load the matching skill with edgegap_get_skill: edgegap-ngo for Unity with Netcode for GameObjects, edgegap-fishnet for Unity with FishNet, edgegap-purrnet for Unity with PurrNet, edgegap-fusion for Unity with Photon Fusion 2, edgegap-unity for other Unity projects, edgegap-unreal for Unreal Engine (edgegap-eos-voice to add voice chat to it), edgegap-fusion-simplefps for the Photon Simple FPS sample, edgegap-godot for Godot 4 with a Godot server, edgegap-colyseus for a Colyseus server, edgegap-nakama for a game with a Nakama backend, edgegap-playfab for a game that keeps PlayFab Matchmaking, edgegap-threejs for a Three.js or other browser game with its own Node.js server, edgegap-manus for a browser game built with Manus, edgegap for any other engine or platform questions; it routes to the rest. Also says whether a newer skills pack is on GitHub (reads one version number, no Edgegap API call).
name: edgegap_list_skills
title: List the Edgegap agent skills
